name: When should I call a plumber for an overflowing toilet?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for an overflowing toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber if you cannot stop the overflow using the shut-off valve, if plunging doesn't resolve the clog, or if the toilet overflows frequently. Recurring overflows or those affecting multiple fixtures in your home (like a sink or shower backing up) can indicate a deeper main sewer line issue. A professional plumber has the tools and expertise to diagnose and fix complex clogs safely and effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if you can't stop the overflow, plunging fails, overflows are frequent, or if multiple fixtures are affected, indicating a main line issue.
